decisions.what: Menu toggle selects '.hamburger' with fallback to '.nav-toggle'
decisions.why: Spec names .hamburger but index.html uses .nav-toggle; fallback keeps the feature working

decisions.what: Scroll animation sets initial/transition styles inline and adds 'visible' class
decisions.why: styles.css has no fade-in/visible rules; hiding only after IntersectionObserver is confirmed avoids invisible content without JS

decisions.what: Lazy loading uses data-src/data-srcset with native loading='lazy' when supported, IntersectionObserver otherwise
decisions.why: Spec requires fallback for browsers without native lazy loading

decisions.what: Smooth scroll uses 'auto' behavior under prefers-reduced-motion
